paper_title: First Results from Axion Haloscope at CAPP around 10.7 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, computed from paper's stated exclusion in units of KSVZ coupling (KSVZ: g_agamma = 0.97*alpha_em/(pi*f_a), f_a*m_a = (78 MeV)^2)
notes: First results from CAPP-PACE haloscope. Paper excludes 10.7126-10.7186 ueV at ~1x KSVZ coupling and 10.16-11.37 ueV at ~9x KSVZ (stated as 8-10x KSVZ) at 90% CL, assuming rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and virialized axion line shape. No numerical table given; coupling values computed from the stated KSVZ multiples using g_KSVZ(m_a) ~ 3.70e-16 GeV^-1 * (m_a/ueV). The wide-range limit is represented as a band at 9x KSVZ with a narrow dip to 1x KSVZ in the KSVZ-run window.
